Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, t  Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents 1 to 5 to shift the Aavin sh  Kamarajar Bus Stand, Alangulam to alternative place of the said bus stan  take action as against the 6th respondent by considering the petitioner'

For Petitioner : Mr.J.David Ganesan  For R1 to R4 : Mr.P.Thilak Kumar,
 Government Pleader  ORDER (Order of the Court was made by S.M.SUBRAMANIAM, J.)

With reference to the grievance of the petitioner, the learned Government Pleader appearing for the respondents 1 to 4 would submit that appropriate actions are taken to maintain the area cleanly, so as to avoid any inconvenience to the people visiting Aavin Shop in the subject location.
2.In view of the said submission, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
